context.body: Selected for the reader trail because “Joseph asks; Pilate confirms; the women see” preserves a distinct parallel witness source unit within burial.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Preparation Day and approaching Sabbath create urgency around the request for the body.
observations.label: Joseph asks; Pilate confirms; the women see: textual observation

observations.body: Pilate is surprised at the death and questions the centurion before granting the body.
observations.label: Joseph asks; Pilate confirms; the women see: action, promise, or consequence

observations.body: Joseph handles the body while Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses see where it is laid.
observations.label: Relationships named in Mark 15:42–47

payload.posture: Read Mark 15:42–47 as its own burial and guarded rest crucifixion setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The burial proceeds only after an official confirmation that the death has already occurred.
payload.title: Joseph asks; Pilate confirms; the women see
